en.s: On 23 January 393, Emperor Theodosius I proclaimed his son Honorius Augustus, making him a co-ruler of the Roman Empire. Honorius later ruled the western part of the empire after his father’s death in 395.

zh.t: 霍诺里乌斯获封奥古斯都
zh.s: 393年1月23日，罗马皇帝狄奥多西一世宣布其子霍诺里乌斯为“奥古斯都”，使他成为帝国共治者。父亲于395年去世后，霍诺里乌斯统治帝国西部。

en.s: The Battle of Loděnice was a conflict that took place in 23 January 1179 near the village Loděnice. It was a clash between two Bohemian princes over the succession of the duchy. Soběslav II defeated Bedřich, who was forced to flee. Despite Soběslav's significant victory, he was eventually routed by Bedřich and Czech prince, Konrád II Ota, who overthrew Soběslav, at the end of the war.

zh.s: 洛杰尼采战役于1179年1月23日在洛杰尼采村附近爆发，是波希米亚两位王公争夺公国继承权的一场冲突。索别斯拉夫二世击败了贝德日赫，迫使他逃走。尽管索别斯拉夫取得重大胜利，但战争结束时，他最终被贝德日赫和捷克王公康拉德二世·奥托击败并推翻。

en.t: Louis IX issues the Mise of Amiens
en.s: On 23 January 1264, King Louis IX of France issued the Mise of Amiens, arbitrating the dispute between Henry III of England and the rebellious barons led by Simon de Montfort. His decision strongly favored Henry and failed to settle the conflict.

zh.t: 路易九世作出《亚眠裁决》
zh.s: 1264年1月23日，法国国王路易九世作出《亚眠裁决》，仲裁英格兰国王亨利三世与西蒙·德·孟福尔率领的反叛贵族之间的争端。裁决明显偏向亨利，未能平息冲突。

en.t: Zhu Yuanzhang proclaims the Ming dynasty
en.s: On 23 January 1368, Zhu Yuanzhang proclaimed himself emperor and named his dynasty the Great Ming in China. He ruled as the Hongwu Emperor.

zh.s: 1368年1月23日，朱元璋在中国称帝，定国号为大明，年号洪武。

en.s: The 1556 Shaanxi earthquake (Chinese: 华县大地震; pinyin: Huáxiàn Dàdìzhèn) or Jiajing earthquake (Chinese: 嘉靖大地震; pinyin: Jiājìng Dàdìzhèn) was a catastrophic earthquake and is also the deadliest earthquake on record, killing approximately 830,000 people. It occurred on the morning of 23 January 1556 in Shaanxi, during the Ming Dynasty. More than 97 counties in the provinces of Shaanxi, Shanxi, Henan, Gansu, Hebei, Shandong, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangsu and Anhui were affected. Buildings were damaged slightly in the cities of Beijing, Chengdu and Shanghai. An 840-kilometre-wide (520 mi) area was destroyed, and in some counties as much as 60% of the population was killed.

zh.s: 1556年1月23日清晨，明朝陕西发生灾难性地震，称华县大地震或嘉靖大地震，约造成83万人死亡，是有记录以来死亡人数最多的地震。陕西、山西、河南、甘肃、河北、山东、湖北、湖南、江苏及安徽等省超过97个县受影响，北京、成都和上海也有建筑轻微受损。宽达840公里的地区遭到破坏，某些县死亡人数高达总人口的60%。

en.s: The Battle of Talikota, also known as that of Rakshasi-Tangadi, (23 January 1565) was a watershed battle fought between the Vijayanagara Empire and an alliance of the Deccan sultanates. The battle resulted in the defeat of Aliya Rama Raya which led to the eventual collapse of the polity and reconfigured Deccan politics.

zh.s: 塔利科塔战役又称拉克沙西—唐加迪战役，于1565年1月23日爆发，是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国与德干苏丹国联盟之间的一场关键战役。阿利亚·拉玛·拉亚战败，最终导致毗奢耶那伽罗政权瓦解，并改变了德干地区的政治格局。

en.s: On 23 January 1570, James Stewart, Earl of Moray and regent of Scotland, was shot in Linlithgow by James Hamilton of Bothwellhaugh, a supporter of Mary, Queen of Scots. Linlithgow is in present-day United Kingdom.

zh.t: 苏格兰摄政莫里伯爵在林利斯戈遇刺
zh.s: 1570年1月23日，苏格兰摄政、莫里伯爵詹姆斯·斯图尔特在林利斯戈遭博斯韦尔豪的詹姆斯·汉密尔顿枪击身亡。凶手支持苏格兰女王玛丽。林利斯戈位于今英国境内。

en.t: Elizabeth I formally opens the Royal Exchange
en.s: On 23 January 1571, Queen Elizabeth I formally opened the Royal Exchange in London, in present-day United Kingdom. She gave the building its royal title and a licence to sell alcohol and valuable goods.

zh.t: 伊丽莎白一世为皇家交易所揭幕
zh.s: 1571年1月23日，伊丽莎白一世女王为伦敦皇家交易所正式揭幕，授予其“皇家”称号，并准许其销售酒类和贵重商品。地点位于今英国境内。

en.s: Battle of Lode was a battle fought during the Livonian War, between Sweden and Russia on 23 January 1573. The battle was won by the Swedes.

zh.s: 1573年1月23日，利沃尼亚战争中的瑞典军队与俄罗斯军队在洛德交战，最终瑞军获胜。

en.s: On January 23, 1576, Pope Gregory XIII established the Diocese of Macau, separating it from the Diocese of Malacca. Its original jurisdiction was much larger than the present-day diocese.

zh.s: 1576年1月23日，教宗额我略十三世下令从马六甲教区划出辖区，设立澳门教区。最初的管辖范围远大于今天的教区。

en.t: The Union of Utrecht forms a Protestant republic in the Netherlands
en.s: The Union of Utrecht (Dutch: Unie van Utrecht) was an alliance based on an agreement concluded on 23 January 1579 between a number of Dutch provinces and cities, to reach a joint commitment against the king, Philip II of Spain. By joining forces, they hoped to force him to stop his harsh administrative measures.

zh.t: 乌得勒支同盟成立荷兰新教共和国
zh.s: 乌得勒支同盟（荷兰语：Unie van Utrecht）是荷兰多个省份和城市于1579年1月23日达成的一项联盟协议。各方联合起来，共同反对西班牙国王腓力二世，希望迫使他停止严厉的行政措施。

en.s: The battle of Leeds took place during the First English Civil War on 23 January 1643, when a Parliamentarian force attacked the Royalist garrison of Leeds, Yorkshire. The attack was partly dictated by the need to maintain local support for the Parliamentarian cause; the Earl of Newcastle had recently shifted the balance of power in Yorkshire in the Royalists' favour with the addition of his 8,000-strong army, and sent one of his commanders, Sir William Savile to capture Leeds.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，议会军于1643年1月23日进攻约克郡利兹的保王党驻军。此举部分是为了维持当地对议会派事业的支持。纽卡斯尔伯爵近期率领8000人的军队加入保王党，使约克郡的战局转向对保王党有利；他随后派威廉·萨维尔爵士率部夺取利兹。

en.t: Pascal’s first Provincial Letter is dated
en.s: The first of Blaise Pascal’s Provincial Letters is dated January 23, 1656. Written in France under a pseudonym, the letters addressed disputes over grace and criticized the Jesuits’ moral arguments.

zh.t: 帕斯卡写下首封《致外省人信札》
zh.s: 布莱兹·帕斯卡《致外省人信札》的第一封信落款为1656年1月23日。这组信札在法国以笔名写成，讨论有关恩典的争论，并批评耶稣会的道德论证。

en.s: On 23 January 1755, Empress Elizabeth decreed the establishment of Moscow University in Russia. The date was January 12 in the Julian calendar then in use.

zh.s: 1755年1月23日，俄罗斯女皇伊丽莎白颁布设立莫斯科大学的法令。这一天对应当时使用的儒略历1月12日。

en.t: Georgetown’s founders receive the campus land deed
en.s: On January 23, 1789, John Carroll, Robert Molyneux and John Ashton received the deed for the land on which Georgetown’s first academy building was already under construction, in what is now Washington, D.C., United States. Georgetown regards this as its founding date; teaching began in late 1791.

zh.t: 乔治敦创办人取得校园土地契据
zh.s: 1789年1月23日，约翰·卡罗尔、罗伯特·莫利纽克斯和约翰·阿什顿取得乔治敦学院校址的土地契据，当时首座校舍已在施工。校址位于今美国华盛顿特区。乔治敦将这一天作为建校日，正式教学则于1791年末开始。

en.t: Capture of the Dutch fleet at Den Helder
en.s: The Capture of the Dutch fleet at Den Helder or the Battle of Texel occurred in the night of the 23 January 1795, and presents a rare occurrence of a "naval" battle between warships and cavalry; a French Hussar regiment surprised a Dutch fleet frozen at anchor between the port of Den Helder and the island of Texel. After an extraordinary charge across the frozen Zuiderzee, the French cavalry captured 14 Dutch ships and 850 guns. This capture of ships by horsemen is a unique feat in military history. Some sources however say that no battle took place, and that Hussars merely accepted the surrender of the Dutch fleet.

zh.t: 法军在登海尔德俘获荷兰舰队
zh.s: 1795年1月23日夜，一支法国骠骑兵团突袭了冻在登海尔德港与特塞尔岛之间锚地上的荷兰舰队，这一事件也称特塞尔之战，是军舰与骑兵之间罕见的“海战”。法军骑兵冲过结冰的须德海，俘获14艘荷兰船只和850门火炮，被视为军事史上骑兵夺舰的独特战绩。不过，一些资料认为并没有实际战斗，骠骑兵只是接受荷兰舰队投降。

en.t: 1857 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1857 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 10th Wisconsin Legislature on January 23, 1857. Incumbent Democratic U.S. senator Henry Dodge did not run for re-election. Former Wisconsin circuit court judge James R. Doolittle was elected United States senator on the first ballot. At the start of the 1857 term, Republicans held large majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, so had more than enough votes to elect a Republican United States senator.

en.s: The Battle of Lubartów, which took place on the night of 22–23 January 1863, was one of the first battles of the January Uprising. Several hundred Polish insurgents, mostly scythemen and some armed with sticks, planned to attack the town of Lubartów, Congress Poland, which was garrisoned by the Imperial Russian Army. Furthermore, the Poles wanted to capture the nearby hamlet of Skrobów, where Russian artillery cannons were kept.

en.s: The Battle of Szydłowiec took place in the night of 22–23 January 1863, during the January Uprising. It began when Polish insurgents under Captain August Jasiński and Colonel Marian Langiewicz attacked the town of Szydłowiec (Congress Poland), where a garrison of the Imperial Russian Army stayed. Szydlowiec was defended by an infantry regiment under Major Rudigier.

en.t: Battle of Sabana de San Pedro
en.s: The Battle of Sabana de San Pedro was a military engagement of the Dominican Restoration War that occurred on January 23, 1864. The Spanish Army under the command of Field Marshal Antonio Abad Alfau defeated the Dominican Liberation Army commanded by General Gregorio Luperón, forcing them to withdraw from the Sabana de San Pedro area.

zh.t: 萨瓦纳德圣佩德罗战役

en.s: The Marias Massacre (also known as the Baker Massacre or the Piegan Massacre) was a massacre of a friendly band of Piegan Blackfeet Indians on January 23, 1870, by the United States Army in Montana Territory during the Indian Wars. About 200 Indians were killed, mostly women, children, and elderly men. During a campaign to suppress Mountain Chief's band of Piegan Blackfeet, (who harbored a man named Owl Child, said to have murdered a white trader and rancher, Malcolm Clarke), the U.S. Army instead attacked a band led by Heavy Runner, a chief who had been promised protection by the United States government.

zh.s: 1870年1月23日，美洲印第安战争期间，美国陆军在蒙大拿领地屠杀一支友善的皮根黑脚族部落，约200人死亡，多为妇女、儿童及老年男子。此事也称贝克屠杀或皮根屠杀。美军本来奉命镇压“山酋长”的部落，该部落庇护了据称杀害白人商人兼牧场主马尔科姆·克拉克的“猫头鹰之子”。但美军实际攻击的，却是“沉重奔跑者”领导的另一支部落，而美国政府曾承诺保护这名酋长。

en.s: The Battle of Rorke's Drift, also known as the Defence of Rorke's Drift, was an engagement in the Anglo-Zulu War. The successful British defence of the Swedish mission station and British supply depot at Rorke's Drift, it was carried out by a vastly outnumbered British force under the command of Lieutenants John Chard of the Royal Engineers and Gonville Bromhead of the 24th Regiment of Foot.

zh.s: 罗克渡口战役又称罗克渡口防御战，是祖鲁战争期间的一场交战。英国军队以少胜多，在皇家工兵团约翰·查德中尉和第24步兵团冈维尔·布罗姆黑德中尉的指挥下，成功守住瑞典传教站和英国补给站。

en.s: The 1883 Manitoba general election was held on January 23, 1883, to elect 31 members to the Legislative Assembly of Manitoba. Incumbent premier John Norquay and his allies won re-election. This was the first partisan election in Manitoba, though the political parties were still unofficial. Norquay himself was officially independent, but he aligned with the Conservative Party, and his MLAs were considered to be the province's de facto Conservative Party.

en.s: The first-ever Elections to Wiltshire County Council were held on 23 January 1889. Sixty members were up for election, with up to twenty more voting aldermen to be appointed by the new council. The first Chairman of the Council was John Thynne, 4th Marquess of Bath, and he remained in office until his death in 1896.

zh.s: 1889年1月23日，威尔特郡议会举行首次选举，改选六十名议员，新议会还可再任命最多二十名有投票权的市参事。首任议长为第四代巴斯侯爵约翰·锡恩，任职直至1896年去世。

en.s: The Battle of Spion Kop (Dutch: Slag bij Spionkop; Afrikaans: Slag van Spioenkop) was fought about 38 km (24 mi) west-south-west of Ladysmith on the hilltop of Spioenkop along the Tugela River, Natal in South Africa from 23–24 January 1900. en.s: The Ålesund fire happened on 23 January 1904 in the Norwegian city of Ålesund. It destroyed almost the whole city centre, built mostly of wood, like the majority of Norwegian towns at the time. The town has since been rebuilt and it is now the administrative centre of Ålesund Municipality.

zh.s: 1904年1月23日，挪威城市奥勒松发生火灾。市中心几乎全部被毁，当时挪威大多数城镇的建筑都以木材为主。此后奥勒松得以重建，如今是奥勒松市镇的行政中心。

en.s: The First International Opium Convention (also called 1912 Opium Convention or Hague Opium Convention) is a former international treaty signed at The Hague in 1912. The conference were an international effort by states to regulate the trade of opium and suppress illicit opium consumption. It was followed in 1925 by the Second International Opium Convention signed in Geneva.
en.n: The First International Opium Convention is signed at The Hague.

zh.s: 第一届国际鸦片公约又称1912年鸦片公约或海牙鸦片公约，是一项于1912年在海牙签署的国际条约。缔约国通过会议共同努力，规范鸦片贸易并打击非法吸食。1925年，各国在日内瓦签署第二届国际鸦片公约。
zh.n: 第一届国际鸦片公约在海牙签署。

en.s: The 1913 Ottoman coup d'état (23 January 1913), also known as the Raid on the Sublime Porte (Turkish: Bâb-ı Âlî Baskını), was a coup d'état carried out in the Ottoman Empire by a number of Committee of Union and Progress (CUP) members led by Ismail Enver Bey and Mehmed Talât Bey, in which the group made a surprise raid on the central Ottoman government buildings, the Sublime Porte (Turkish: Bâb-ı Âlî).

zh.s: 1913年奥斯曼政变又称“突袭高门”（土耳其语：Bâb-ı Âlî Baskını），于1913年1月23日发生。统一进步委员会成员发动政变，领导者包括伊斯梅尔·恩维尔贝伊和穆罕默德·塔拉特贝伊。他们突然袭击奥斯曼帝国中央政府所在地高门。

en.s: The 1913 Tasmanian state election was held on Thursday, 23 January 1913 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 30 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — six members were elected from each of five electorates. The 1913 election was called less than a year after the 1912 election.

en.t: Regional Congress of Peasants, Workers and Insurgents
en.s: The Regional Congresses of Peasants, Workers and Insurgents represented the "highest form of democratic authority" within the political system of the Makhnovshchina. They brought together delegates from the region's peasantry, industrial workers and insurgent soldiers, which would discuss the issues at hand and take their decisions back with them to local popular assemblies.

zh.s: 农民、工人与起义者地区代表大会是马赫诺运动政治体系中“最高形式的民主权力”。大会汇集各地农民、产业工人和起义军士兵的代表，讨论当时的问题，再将决定带回当地的民众大会。

en.s: The Chilean coup d'état of 1925 took place on January 23, 1925, when the Chilean military overthrew the September Junta. Led by Colonel Marmaduque Grove, the troops arrested the Junta's President, General Luis Altamirano, and then handed the power to General Pedro Dartnell as interim President. The organizers of the coup hoped to recall former president Arturo Alessandri, who had been forced into exile after the September Junta's coming to power. However, General Dartnell ultimately refused to rule alone and formed the January Junta a few days later, handing power to Emilio Bello Codecido.

zh.s: 1925年1月23日，智利军队推翻“九月军政府”。马马杜克·格罗韦上校率军逮捕军政府主席路易斯·阿尔塔米拉诺将军，把权力交给佩德罗·达特内尔将军担任临时总统。政变组织者希望召回前总统阿图罗·亚历山德里，他在九月军政府上台后被迫流亡。但达特内尔最终拒绝独自执政，数日后组成“一月军政府”，将权力交给埃米利奥·贝略·科德西多。

en.s: Between 21 and 23 January 1941, a rebellion of the Iron Guard paramilitary organization, whose members were known as Legionnaires, occurred in Bucharest, Romania. As their privileges were being gradually removed by the Conducător Ion Antonescu, the Legionnaires revolted. During the rebellion and subsequent pogrom, the Iron Guard killed 125 Jews, and 30 soldiers died in the confrontation with the rebels.

zh.t: 铁卫团叛乱与布加勒斯特反犹屠杀
zh.s: 1941年1月21日至23日，罗马尼亚布加勒斯特发生铁卫团叛乱。这个准军事组织的成员也称军团分子，因领袖扬·安东内斯库逐步削减其特权而起事。叛乱及随后的反犹屠杀中，铁卫团杀害125名犹太人，另有30名士兵在与叛军交战中死亡。

en.s: On 23 January 1942, the German-led Operation Southeast Croatia was called off after failing to destroy the Yugoslav Partisan forces it targeted. The operation had begun on January 15 in eastern Bosnia, in present-day Bosnia and Herzegovina.

zh.s: 1942年1月23日，德军主导的“克罗地亚东南部行动”停止，未能消灭其针对的南斯拉夫游击队。这次行动于1月15日在波斯尼亚东部展开，地点位于今波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那境内。

en.s: The New Guinea campaign of the Pacific War lasted from January 1942 until the end of the war in August 1945. During the initial phase in early 1942, the Empire of Japan invaded the Territory of New Guinea on 23 January and Territory of Papua on 21 July and overran western New Guinea (part of the Netherlands East Indies) beginning on 29 March.

en.s: The Battle of Tripoli was an engagement on between the German-Italian Panzer Army commanded by Erwin Rommel of Nazi Germany and Ettore Bastico of Kingdom of Italy, who held the town, and the British 8th Army, a Commonwealth force commanded by Sir Bernard Montgomery. en.t: Battle of Mount Austen, the Galloping Horse, and the Sea Horse
en.s: The Battle of Mount Austen, the Galloping Horse, and the Sea Horse, part of which is sometimes called the Battle of the Gifu, or the Battle of the Mountain of Blood among the Japanese, took place from 15 December 1942 to 23 January 1943 and was primarily an engagement between United States and Imperial Japanese forces in the hills near the Matanikau River area on Guadalcanal during the Guadalcanal campaign.

zh.s: 奥斯汀山、奔马山与海马山战役又称吉夫战役，日本方面有时称血山战役，于1942年12月15日至1943年1月23日进行，是瓜达尔卡纳尔战役期间的一场主要战斗。交战双方是美国和日本帝国军队，战场位于瓜达尔卡纳尔岛马坦尼考河一带的山丘。

en.s: The Koplik Uprising (Albanian: Kryengritja e Koplikut) was an anti-communist armed revolt in Albania that took place on January 23, 1945. In Koplik, the center of Malësia e Madhe. It was one of the earliest uprisings against the ruling Communist Party in Eastern Europe. The uprising occurred under national-democratic ideas and was eventually suppressed by state security forces.

zh.t: 阿尔巴尼亚科普利克起义
zh.s: 1945年1月23日，阿尔巴尼亚马莱西亚马德地区中心科普利克，爆发反共产主义武装起义。这是东欧最早反对执政共产党统治的起义之一，以民族民主理念为号召，最终遭国家安全部队镇压。

en.s: Operation Hannibal was a German naval operation involving the evacuation by sea of German troops and civilians from the Courland Pocket, East Prussia, West Prussia and Pomerania from mid-January to May 1945 as the Red Army advanced during the East Prussian and East Pomeranian Offensives and subsidiary operations. The operation was one of the largest evacuations by sea in history.
en.n: World War II: German admiral Karl Dönitz launches Operation Hannibal, the evacuation of areas along the eastern Baltic coast.

zh.s: 汉尼拔行动是德国海军于1945年1月中旬至5月执行的一次海上撤离行动。随着红军推进，德军从库尔兰口袋、东普鲁士、西普鲁士和波美拉尼亚海上撤出军队和平民。行动配合东普鲁士和东波美拉尼亚攻势及相关军事行动，是历史上规模最大的海上撤离之一。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：德国海军上将卡尔·邓尼茨启动汉尼拔行动，从波罗的海东岸地区撤离人员。

en.s: The 1st Legislative Yuan election was held in China between 21 and 23 January 1948. This election, and the preceding 1947 National Assembly election are the first elections of under the newly ratified 1947 Constitution of the Republic of China. Under this constitution, the Legislative Yuan is a standing legislature when the National Assembly is not in session.

zh.s: 1948年1月21日至23日，中国举行第一届立法院选举。此次选举及此前的1947年国民大会选举，是新近通过的1947年《中华民国宪法》下首批选举。根据该宪法，国民大会闭会时，由立法院作为常设立法机关。

en.s: General elections were held in Japan on 23 January 1949. The result was a victory for the Democratic Liberal Party, which won 269 of the 466 seats. Voter turnout was 74.0%. It was the first election held following the enactment of the current Constitution of Japan. Future prime ministers Hayato Ikeda and Eisaku Satō and future Foreign Minister and Chief Cabinet Secretary Katsuo Okazaki were first elected in this election. The second cabinet of Prime Minister Shigeru Yoshida was formed following the election.

zh.s: 1949年1月23日，日本举行大选，民主自由党赢得466席中的269席，投票率为74.0%。这是现行《日本国宪法》颁布后的首次选举。后来的首相池田勇人、佐藤荣作，以及后来的外务大臣、内阁官房长官冈崎胜男，均在此次首次当选。选后组成吉田茂第二届内阁。

en.s: The APRA coup d’état (Indonesian: Peristiwa Kudeta Angkatan Perang Ratu Adil) or the January 23 coup d’état (Indonesian: Kudeta 23 Januari) was a coup d'état by Raymond Westerling's Legion of the Just Ruler (APRA) to capture Bandung and Jakarta, with the aim to overthrow Sukarno's unitary Republic of Indonesia. Westerling was a demobilised Dutch Captain of the KNIL (Royal Netherlands East Indies Army), who sought to preserve the federal Republic of the United States of Indonesia, which retained the support of the Netherlands and various minority elements. Westerling's forces succeeded in capturing Bandung in the early hours of 23 January 1950.

zh.s: APRA政变又称1月23日政变，是雷蒙德·韦斯特林率领的“公正统治者军团”发动的一场政变，目标是攻占万隆和雅加达，推翻苏加诺领导的印度尼西亚单一制共和国。韦斯特林曾是荷属东印度皇家陆军的荷兰上尉，退役后试图维护印度尼西亚联邦共和国；荷兰和一些少数群体支持这个联邦国家。1950年1月23日凌晨，韦斯特林的部队成功攻占万隆。

en.t: Chinese prisoners from the Korean War begin arriving in Taiwan
en.s: On January 23, 1954, Chinese prisoners of war who had declined repatriation to the People’s Republic of China began arriving in Taiwan. January 23 was subsequently commemorated there as World Freedom Day.

zh.t: 朝鲜战争中的中国战俘开始抵达台湾

en.s: The 1958 Venezuelan coup d'état took place on 23 January 1958, when the dictator Marcos Pérez Jiménez was overthrown. A transition government under first Adm. Wolfgang Larrazábal and then Edgar Sanabria was put in place until December 1958 elections saw Democratic Action candidate Rómulo Betancourt elected and take office on 13 February 1959. One of Caracas' neighbourhoods, Barrio 23 de Enero (23 January neighbourhood), is named for the event.

zh.s: 1958年1月23日，独裁者马科斯·佩雷斯·希门尼斯被推翻。过渡政府先由沃尔夫冈·拉腊萨瓦尔海军将领领导，再由埃德加·萨纳夫里亚接替。1958年12月选举中，民主行动党候选人罗慕洛·贝坦科尔特当选，并于1959年2月13日就任。加拉加斯的“一月二十三日区”，就是为纪念这次事件命名。

en.s: The 1962 Israel Super Cup was the 2nd Israel Super Cup, an annual Israeli football match played between the winners of the previous season's Top Division and Israel State Cup. As the match was not set by the Israel Football Association, it was considered an unofficial cup, with the cup being donated by Ilanshil-Polio, an Israeli organization dedicated to aid Poliomyelitis victims, with proceedings going towards the organization. The match, held on 23 January 1963, ended in a 2–2 draw and the cup was shared by the teams.

zh.s: 1963年1月23日，第二届以色列超级杯举行，由上赛季顶级联赛与国家杯冠军对决。由于比赛并非以色列足协安排，因此被视为非官方杯赛。奖杯由援助脊髓灰质炎患者的以色列组织Ilanshil-Polio捐赠，收入也捐给该组织。比赛最终2比2战平，两队共享奖杯。

en.s: The Guinea-Bissau War of Independence (Portuguese: Guerra de Independência da Guiné-Bissau), also known as the Bissau-Guinean War of Independence, was an armed independence conflict that took place in Portuguese Guinea from 1963 to 1974. It was fought between Portugal and the African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde (Partido Africano da Independência da Guiné e Cabo Verde, PAIGC), an armed independence movement backed by the Soviet Union, China, Cuba, Algeria and Guinea.

en.t: The 24th Amendment to the United States Constitution, prohibiting the use of poll taxes in national elections, is ratified
en.s: The Twenty-fourth Amendment (Amendment XXIV) of the United States Constitution prohibits both Congress and the states from requiring the payment of a poll tax or any other tax to vote in federal elections. en.s: The 1986 Belfast East by-election was one of the fifteen 1986 Northern Ireland by-elections held on 23 January 1986, to fill vacancies in the Parliament of the United Kingdom caused by the resignation in December 1985 of all sitting Unionist Members of Parliament (MPs). The MPs, from the Ulster Unionist Party, Democratic Unionist Party and Ulster Popular Unionist Party, did this to highlight their opposition to the Anglo-Irish Agreement. Each of their parties agreed not to contest seats previously held by the others, and each outgoing MP stood for re-election.

en.s: The 1986 by-election in Newry and Armagh was caused by the resignation of incumbent Member of Parliament Jim Nicholson. Nicholson, along with all sitting Unionist MPs, resigned their Westminster seats in December 1985, to highlight their opposition to the Anglo-Irish Agreement and to use the resultant by-elections to campaign on the issue. The poll was held on 23 January 1986, and was unusual for a by-election in the turnout being higher than for the preceding General Election, however Nicholson was not re-elected, losing his seat to the nationalist SDLP candidate Seamus Mallon. Nicholson also failed to recapture the seat at the following general election.

en.s: The 2006 Canadian federal election (more formally, the 39th General Election) was held on January 23, 2006, to elect members of the House of Commons of Canada of the 39th Parliament of Canada. The Conservative Party of Canada won the greatest number of seats: 40.3% of seats, or 124 out of 308, up from 99 seats in 2004, and 36.3% of votes: up from 29.6% in the 2004 election. The election resulted in a minority government led by the Conservative Party with Stephen Harper becoming the 22nd Prime Minister of Canada. By proportion of seats, this was Canada's smallest minority government since Confederation.
